name: Inaba Shouko
source:
An old friend of the protagonist. She's always been infatuated with him, often greeting him with tackle hugs, and addressing him as "Senpai". She's never seen without her friend Satomi.

She decides to join him in working at Pia Carrot, so that she can be with him every day during summer break.
